| [Skeleton](#skeleton) | Feedback | stable | Placeholder blocks that hold the layout while content loads. |
| [Spinner](#spinner) | Feedback | stable | TUI loading indicator in the 1-bit icon language: eight square dots on an 8x8 pixel grid with a two-dot gap that steps clockwise around the ring (100ms per frame). |

| [Checkbox](#checkbox) | Inputs | stable | Checkbox lets users turn an independent option on or off, or pick any number of items from a list, usually as part of a form that is submitted later. |
| [Combobox](#combobox) | Inputs | stable | Text input with a filtered listbox for choosing one option from a long list. |
| [Fieldset](#fieldset) | Inputs | stable | Fieldset names a group of related controls: radios that answer one question, a set of checkboxes, or a titled group of settings inside a Card. |
| [Input](#input) | Inputs | stable | Input is the single-line text field for short free-form values: names, emails, search terms, codes. |
| [Radio](#radio) | Inputs | stable | Radio lets users choose exactly one option from a small, visible set (roughly two to five). |
| [Select](#select) | Inputs | stable | Select picks one value from a list of options inside a form. |
| [Slider](#slider) | Inputs | stable | Slider picks a numeric value from a continuous or stepped range, such as zoom level, size, or bias, where the relative position matters more than typing an exact number. |
| [Switch](#switch) | Inputs | stable | Switch toggles a setting on or off with an immediate effect, like enabling notifications or a theme. |
| [Textarea](#textarea) | Inputs | stable | Textarea is the multi-line text field for longer free-form input: notes, feedback, descriptions. |
| [Box](#box) | Layout | stable | Box is the base surface primitive: token-backed padding, a semantic background, and the optional hairline plate ring, on the element of your choice. |
| [Center](#center) | Layout | stable | Center puts one column of content in the middle of its parent: a measured width, optionally centered text, and optionally the full viewport height. |
| [Container](#container) | Layout | stable | Container is the page-width wrapper: one max width, one set of gutters, one place to change either. |
| [Grid](#grid) | Layout | stable | Grid is the two-dimensional layout primitive: a token-backed gap and a column count that can change per breakpoint. |
| [Inline](#inline) | Layout | stable | Inline is the horizontal cluster: a row of items that wraps onto the next line instead of overflowing. |
| [Stack](#stack) | Layout | stable | Stack is the layout primitive for spacing a group of elements along one axis with a gap from the spacing scale. |
| [VisuallyHidden](#visuallyhidden) | Layout | stable | VisuallyHidden renders content that screen readers announce and nobody sees: the word "Close" in an icon button, a caption for a table, the "Skip to content" link at the top of a page. |
| [AppHeader](#appheader) | Navigation | stable | The application top bar: a `<header>` with `brand`, `navigation`, and `actions` slots. |
| [Breadcrumbs](#breadcrumbs) | Navigation | stable | Shows where the current page sits in a hierarchy: a `<nav aria-label="Breadcrumb">` landmark around an ordered list of links, ending on the current page (plain text with `aria-current="page"`). |
| [Link](#link) | Navigation | stable | Link is the inline text link for navigation inside prose, captions, nav lists and footers. |
| [Pagination](#pagination) | Navigation | stable | Page picker for long, paged collections. |
| [SideNav](#sidenav) | Navigation | stable | The Patterns/SideNavigation recipe as a compound component: `SideNav` > `SideNavSection` (optional heading naming a group) > `SideNavItem`. |
| [Tabs](#tabs) | Navigation | stable | Tabs switch between related views that share one context, such as the sections of a settings screen, without leaving the page. |
| [BottomSheet](#bottomsheet) | Overlays | stable | BottomSheet is a panel that slides up from the bottom edge over a scrim, for menus and quick actions that dismiss easily: a site menu on mobile, a short list of options, a share sheet. |
| [Dropdown](#dropdown) | Overlays | stable | Dropdown is an action menu: a trigger that opens a short list of commands such as Edit, Duplicate, or Delete. |
| [Modal](#modal) | Overlays | stable | Modal is a centered dialog over a scrim that interrupts the page for a task or decision the user must finish or dismiss before going back: confirmations, short forms, reward claims. |
| [Popover](#popover) | Overlays | stable | Anchored, non-modal floating panel for rich interactive content next to a trigger (filters, a small form, a details card). |

| [CaseStudy](#casestudy) | Patterns | stable | CaseStudy renders long-form narrative pages (case studies, write-ups, project pages) from data. |
| [CodeBlock](#codeblock) | Terminal | stable | CodeBlock shows read-only code: a snippet in a chat reply, the generated source of a layout, a config file. |
| [DescriptionList](#descriptionlist) | Terminal | stable | Term and value pairs on a real `<dl>`: metadata panels, config readouts, neofetch-style summaries. |
| [Kbd](#kbd) | Terminal | stable | Inline keyboard key for shortcut hints. |
| [LogView](#logview) | Terminal | stable | A monospace scrolling log: build output, server logs, job runs. |
| [Meter](#meter) | Terminal | stable | A gauge for a value in a known range (disk, quota, battery), not a progress bar. `role="meter"` with `aria-valuenow` / `min` / `max` / `aria-valuetext`, drawn as stepped blocks on the pixel grid. |
| [StatusLine](#statusline) | Terminal | stable | The bottom bar of a terminal app (vim, tmux): `left`, `center`, and `right` zones of `StatusLineSegment`s. |
| [TreeView](#treeview) | Terminal | stable | Hierarchical list with expandable branches (file trees, outlines). |
| [Window](#window) | Terminal | stable | A framed terminal pane: the large plate ring (stroke layer + fill inset 1px), a TUI title bar (title, a hairline rule filling the gap, optional `status` text and `actions`), and a keyboard-focusable scroll body named by the title. |
| [ThemeToggle](#themetoggle) | Theme | stable | ThemeToggle is a ready-made light/dark control: a small `Switch` with a 1-bit Moon or Sun icon in the knob and a "Dark" / "Light" label beside it. |

## Actions

### Button

Button triggers an action in place: submitting a form, opening a dialog, saving, deleting.

**Use instead:** `variant="link"` is still a button styled as text, for in-place actions like "Show more"; to navigate to another page use the `Link` component, or pass `href` when a navigation needs to look like a plate CTA.

`import { Button } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/Button.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/Button.md) · Story: `Components/Actions/Button`

**`ButtonProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `variant` | `"primary"` `"secondary"` `"ghost"` `"link"` `"outline"` `"destructive"` `"icon"` | `"primary"` | Visual style (default: "primary"). |
| `size` | `"sm"` `"md"` `"lg"` | `"md"` | Height: sm 32px, md 40px (default), lg 48px, from the control-height tokens. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the button (anchors drop `href` and set `aria-disabled`). |
| `iconLeft` | `IconSlot \| React.ReactNode` |  | Icon before the label, usually a `TuiIcon`, to make the action quicker to recognise ("+ New"). |
| `iconRight` | `IconSlot \| React.ReactNode` |  | Icon after the label, for direction or destination (an arrow on "Next", an external-link glyph on a link CTA). |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` | Busy state for async actions (submitting, saving). |
| `href` | `string` |  | Render as an `<a>` with this destination instead of a `<button>`: same plate styling for link CTAs ("view project ↗"). |
| `target` | `string` |  | Anchor target, e.g. "_blank". |
| `rel` | `string` |  | Anchor rel; pair `target="_blank"` with "noopener noreferrer". |

Also accepts the native attributes of `AriaAttributes`, `ButtonHTMLAttributes`, `DOMAttributes`, `HTMLAttributes`.

## Chat

### Composer

Composer is the prompt box of a chat surface.

**Use instead:** a multi-line field in a form, where Enter must insert a line break (use `Textarea` instead), a one-line search or filter (use `Input` instead), or picking from a known list of commands (use `Combobox` instead).

`import { Composer } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/Composer.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/Composer.md) · Story: `Components/Chat/Composer`

**`ComposerProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `string` |  | Controlled text. |
| `defaultValue` | `string` | `""` | Starting text when uncontrolled (default ""). |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: string) => void` |  | Fires on every edit with the new text, and with "" when an uncontrolled Composer clears itself after a send. |
| `onSubmit` (required) | `(value: string) => void` |  | Fires with the trimmed text on Enter (per `submitKey`) or the send button, only when the text is not blank and the Composer is neither `busy` nor `disabled`. |
| `busy` | `boolean` | `false` | A reply is streaming. |
| `onStop` | `() => void` |  | Called by the stop button while `busy`. |
| `submitKey` | `"enter"` `"mod-enter"` | `"enter"` | `enter` (default): Enter sends, Shift+Enter breaks the line. `mod-enter`: Cmd/Ctrl+Enter sends, for long multi-paragraph messages. |
| `minRows` | `number` | `1` | Rows shown when empty (default 1). |
| `maxRows` | `number` | `8` | Rows the field grows to before it scrolls instead (default 8). |
| `size` | `"md"` `"lg"` | `"md"` | Type size, padding and send button size: `md` (default), or `lg` for a prompt that leads the page. |
| `context` | `ReactNode` |  | Row of chips above the field for what the message refers to: attachments, referenced components (`@Card`). |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` |  | Leading actions in the action row (attach, insert): ghost icon-only Buttons with `type="button"` and an `aria-label`. |
| `hint` | `ReactNode \| false` |  | Text before the send button, linked to the field as its description. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `"Message"` | Placeholder text (default "Message"). |
| `label` | `ReactNode` |  | Visible label above the plate, wired to the field; one of `label`, `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` is required. |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the field when there is no visible label, such as "Message"; one of `label`, `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` is required. |
| `aria-labelledby` | `string` |  | Id of visible text elsewhere that names the field, such as the pane title. |
| `helperText` | `ReactNode` |  | Hint under the plate (a character limit, why typing is off), linked as a description. |
| `errorMessage` | `ReactNode` |  | Error under the plate. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the field, the actions and the send button together (one disabled fieldset) and dims the plate to 50%. |
| `maxLength` | `number` |  | Native character limit on the field. |
| `sendLabel` | `string` | `"Send message"` | Accessible name of the send button (default "Send message"). |
| `stopLabel` | `string` | `"Stop response"` | Accessible name of the stop button (default "Stop response"). |
| `name` | `string` |  | Field `name`, for native form handling. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes for the ring wrapper (margin). |

### Message

Message is one turn in a conversation.

**Use instead:** Don't use this for: a line of machine output with no speaker (use `LogView` instead), a notice about the page or a failed action outside a conversation (use `Alert` instead), or an item in a list people pick from (use `ListRow` instead).

`import { Message } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/Message.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/Message.md) · Story: `Components/Chat/Message`

**`MessageProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `author` (required) | `"user"` `"assistant"` `"system"` |  | Who the turn is from: `user` (prompt marker and plate), `assistant` (plain output) or `system` (one muted line). |
| `label` | `ReactNode` |  | Visible role label, which also names the turn for screen readers (default "You", "Scorp" or "System"). |
| `meta` | `ReactNode` |  | Secondary header text after the label: a time, the model, "replayed". |
| `status` | `"done"` `"streaming"` `"stopped"` `"error"` | `"done"` | `done` (default); `streaming` adds the block cursor and `aria-busy`; `stopped` adds a "Stopped" footer; `error` adds the error footer with `errorMessage`. |
| `errorMessage` | `ReactNode` | `"Something went wrong."` | Footer text when `status="error"` (default "Something went wrong."). |
| `onRetry` | `() => void` |  | Adds a Retry button to the error footer. |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` |  | Header actions (copy, retry, edit): ghost `size="sm"` icon-only Buttons with `type="button"` and an `aria-label`. |
| `children` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | The turn's content. |
| `id` | `string` |  | Anchor id, for linking to a turn. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes for the article (margin). |

### Transcript

Transcript is the scrolling region that holds a conversation's `Message`s, oldest first.

**Use instead:** machine output with no turns, such as build or server logs (use `LogView` instead), a list of records people scan and act on (use `ListRow` or `Table` instead), or a feed of notifications (use `Toast` instead).

`import { Transcript } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/Transcript.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/Transcript.md) · Story: `Components/Chat/Transcript`

**`TranscriptProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` | `ReactNode` |  | Messages, oldest first. |
| `busy` | `boolean` | `false` | A reply is streaming. |
| `autoScroll` | `boolean` | `true` | Follow new content to the bottom (default true). |
| `emptyState` | `ReactNode` |  | Shown centered when there are no children. |
| `width` | `"sm"` `"md"` `"lg"` `"full"` | `"md"` | Max width of the content column: `sm`, `md` (default), `lg` or `full`, on the Container scale. |
| `framed` | `boolean` | `false` | Draw the plate ring, as LogView does (default false: a Transcript usually fills a pane that is already framed, such as a Window). |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the log region, such as "Conversation"; this or `aria-labelledby` is required. |
| `aria-labelledby` | `string` |  | Id of visible text that names the log region, such as the pane title. |
| `onFollowChange` | `(following: boolean) => void` |  | Fires with `false` when following pauses (the reader scrolled up) and `true` when it resumes. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes for the wrapper. |

## Display

### Accordion

Stacked sections that expand and collapse under headings.

**Use instead:** switching between alternative views of the same content (use Tabs instead), a nested hierarchy such as files or an outline (use TreeView instead), or anything the user must not miss, which should stay visible rather than collapsed.

`import { Accordion, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger, AccordionContent } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/Accordion.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/Accordion.md) · Story: `Components/Display/Accordion`

**`AccordionSingleProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | AccordionItem children. |
| `headingLevel` | `2` `3` `4` `5` `6` |  | Heading level wrapping each trigger, to fit the page outline (default 3). |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable every item. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes for the root. |
| `type` | `"single"` |  | One item open at a time (default). |
| `value` | `string` |  | Controlled open item value (`""` for none). |
| `defaultValue` | `string` |  | Initially open item when uncontrolled. |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: string) => void` |  | Called with the open item's value (`""` when all are closed). |
| `collapsible` | `boolean` |  | Allow closing the open item so none are open (default false). |

**`AccordionMultipleProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | AccordionItem children. |
| `headingLevel` | `2` `3` `4` `5` `6` |  | Heading level wrapping each trigger, to fit the page outline (default 3). |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disable every item. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes for the root. |
| `type` (required) | `"multiple"` |  | Any number of items open at once. |

| `collapsible` | `boolean` |  | Has no effect with `type="multiple"`: every item can always close, so the accordion behaves as collapsible whatever you pass. |
