### Avatar

Avatar is a square plate that represents a person or entity in profiles, comments, identity headers, and team lists.

**Use instead:** a generic icon (use TuiIcon instead) or a status shown on its own (use Badge instead, which pairs the colour with text).

`import { Avatar } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/Avatar.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/Avatar.md) · Story: `Components/Display/Avatar`

**`AvatarProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `src` | `string` |  | Image URL. |
| `alt` (required) | `string` |  | Who the avatar shows, usually the person's name. |
| `initials` | `string` |  | One or two letters shown when there is no image, or the image fails to load. |
| `icon` | `IconSlot \| ReactNode` |  | Icon shown when there is neither an image nor initials (for a team, a bot, a system account). |
| `size` | `"xl"` `"sm"` `"md"` `"lg"` | `"md"` | Diameter: sm 24px, md 40px (default), lg 64px, xl 96px. |
| `status` | `"online"` `"offline"` `"away"` |  | Presence dot in the corner, announced as "Status: online" and so on. |
| `className` | `string` | `""` | Extra classes on the outer wrapper (margin, positioning). |
| `onError` | `() => void` |  | Called when `src` fails to load (to log it, or swap the URL); the avatar shows its fallback either way. |

### Card

Card is the standard container for a self-contained group of content on a page: a settings group, a profile, a testimonial, a deploy summary.

**Use instead:** For a dialog that interrupts the page use Modal; for dense repeated rows use ListRow or Table.

`import { Card } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/Card.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/Card.md) · Story: `Components/Display/Card`

**`CardProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | `string` |  | Card title, rendered as the header heading (an `h3`). |
| `subtitle` | `string` |  | Supporting line under the title. |
| `headerContent` | `ReactNode` |  | Custom header node, for a header that needs more than a title and subtitle (a badge, an action). |
| `children` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | Main card content. |
| `footerContent` | `ReactNode` |  | Footer node (buttons, links) behind a hairline rule. |
| `layout` | `"block"` `"flex"` | `"block"` | Section layout. `block` (default) lets the card grow with its content. `flex` makes the card a flex column whose content section fills the remaining height, so a fixed-height card can pin its footer to the bottom. |
| `className` | `string` | `""` | Additional CSS classes (width, height, margin). |

### Divider

Divider is a thin rule that separates groups of content within the same surface: sections of a form, items in a toolbar, blocks inside a Card body.

**Use instead:** space alone between items that are already clearly grouped (use the `gap` of Stack or Inline instead), or as the only signal that groups differ in meaning (use a heading instead).

`import { Divider } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/Divider.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/Divider.md) · Story: `Components/Display/Divider`

**`DividerProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `orientation` | `"horizontal"` `"vertical"` | `"horizontal"` | `horizontal` (default) for a full-width rule between stacked blocks; `vertical` for a full-height rule between items in a row (the parent needs a height). |
| `label` | `ReactNode` |  | Centred label on a horizontal rule ("or", a section name), drawn between two hairline runs that fill the width beside it. |
| `spacing` | `"none"` `"sm"` `"md"` `"lg"` | `"md"` | Margin around the rule: none, sm 4px, md 16px (default), lg 32px. |
| `className` | `string` | `""` | Extra classes on the rule (width, colour override, alignment). |

### ListRow

ListRow is the list and navigation tier of the container system, promoted from the portfolio's plate row: a meta line, a title and an optional description, clipped to the small plate.

**Use instead:** Use `Card` for framed content panels and `Table` for data with comparable columns; a ListRow has one text column (plus an optional thumbnail) and no column alignment across rows.

`import { ListRow } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/ListRow.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/ListRow.md) · Story: `Components/Display/ListRow`

**`ListRowProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | `ReactNode` |  | Small line above the title (date, category). |
| `title` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | Row title. |
| `description` | `ReactNode` |  | Supporting line below the title. |
| `titleSuffix` | `ReactNode` |  | Trailing affordance next to the title (e.g. an external-link glyph). |
| `thumb` | `ReactNode` |  | Thumbnail slot beside the text (a sized <img> or framed node; the row reserves the slot with flex-shrink: 0 and never scales it). |
| `thumbPosition` | `"start"` `"end"` | `"start"` | Which side the thumbnail sits on (default "start"). |
| `selected` | `boolean` | `false` | Marks the row as the current selection (the active nav route, the chosen item): the row holds the hover state — surface.muted fill, accent title — per the SideNavigation pattern (fill + color, never color alone, never weight). |
| `className` | `string` | `""` | Extra classes on the row element (padding overrides, a divider border between rows). |
| `href` | `string` |  | Destination URL: the row renders as an `<a>` and navigates. |
| `onClick` | `never` |  |  |
| `as` | `never` |  |  |

Also accepts the native attributes of `AriaAttributes`, `DOMAttributes`, `HTMLAttributes`.

### Table

Table is a set of thin, semantic wrappers over native table elements (`Table`, `TableHeader`, `TableBody`, `TableFooter`, `TableRow`, `TableHead`, `TableCell`) with token-backed chrome for dense monospace data: build status, hosts, inventories, anything read across columns.

**Use instead:** Use it when values need to line up and be compared; use `ListRow` for scannable lists with one text column, and `Card` for framed content.

`import { Table, TableHeader, TableBody, TableFooter, TableRow, TableHead, TableCell } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/Table.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/Table.md) · Story: `Components/Display/Table`

**`TableProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `striped` | `boolean` |  | Zebra striping for body rows (even rows use `surface-subtle`). |
| `bordered` | `boolean` |  | Full outer border around the table. |
| `density` | `"compact"` `"comfortable"` `"spacious"` | `"compact"` | Row padding rhythm (default `compact`); cells read it via context. |

Also accepts the native attributes of `AriaAttributes`, `DOMAttributes`, `HTMLAttributes`, `TableHTMLAttributes`.

**`TableBodyProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` | Show placeholder rows instead of the children while the data loads. |
| `loadingRows` | `number` | `3` | How many Skeleton rows `loading` shows (default 3). |
| `emptyState` | `ReactNode` |  | What to show when the body has no rows: a sentence, or an `EmptyState size="sm"`. |
| `colSpan` | `number` |  | Columns the loading and empty rows span. |

Also accepts the native attributes of `AriaAttributes`, `DOMAttributes`, `HTMLAttributes`.

### TuiIcon

TuiIcon is the system's only icon component: 52 names drawn as 1-bit pixel art on a 7x7 grid.

**Use instead:** a loading state (use Spinner instead) or a person or account (use Avatar instead).

`import { TuiIcon } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/TuiIcon.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/TuiIcon.md) · Story: `Components/Display/TuiIcon`

**`TuiIconProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` (required) | `"AlertCircle"` `"AlertTriangle"` `"Archive"` `"ArrowLeft"` `"ArrowRight"` `"Bell"` `"Check"` `"CheckCircle"` `"ChevronDown"` `"ChevronRight"` `"ChevronUp"` `"Copy"` `"Download"` `"Edit"` `"ExternalLink"` `"Eye"` `"EyeOff"` `"FileText"` `"Globe"` `"HelpCircle"` `"Info"` `"Lock"` `"LogOut"` `"Mail"` `"Menu"` `"Minus"` `"Moon"` `"MoreVertical"` `"Music2"` `"Pause"` `"Play"` `"Plus"` `"Repeat"` `"Save"` `"Search"` `"Send"` `"Settings"` `"Share2"` `"Shield"` `"Shuffle"` `"SkipBack"` `"SkipForward"` `"Star"` `"Stop"` `"Sun"` `"Tag"` `"Trash2"` `"Upload"` `"User"` `"Volume2"` `"VolumeX"` `"X"` |  | Which icon to draw: a (the Lucide component name, e.g. `"Check"`, `"ChevronRight"`). |
| `size` | `"3"` `"4"` `"5"` `"6"` `"8"` | `"4"` | Box size as a Tailwind size number: "3" (12px), "4" (16px, default), "5" (20px), "6" (24px), "8" (32px). |
| `className` | `string` |  | Additional CSS classes (color, margin, etc.) |

## Feedback

### Alert

Alert is an inline, persistent message that sits in the page flow next to the content it describes: a failed save above a form, a warning at the top of a settings panel, a neutral notice about a changed default.

**Use instead:** Use Toast instead for brief, non-critical confirmations that should disappear on their own, and Modal when the user must respond before continuing.

`import { Alert } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/Alert.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/Alert.md) · Story: `Components/Feedback/Alert`

**`AlertProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tone` | `"neutral"` `"info"` `"success"` `"warning"` `"error"` | `"neutral"` | Severity: picks the colour set and the 1-bit severity icon. |
| `title` | `string` |  | Short bold headline, one line. |
| `description` | `ReactNode` |  | Body copy under the title: what it means and what to do next. |
| `iconLeft` | `IconSlot \| ReactNode` |  | Replaces the tone's severity icon. |
| `onDismiss` | `() => void` |  | Adds a dismiss control (44px hit area) and is called when it is pressed. |
| `dismissLabel` | `string` | `"Close alert"` | Accessible name of the dismiss button (default "Close alert"). |
| `className` | `string` | `""` | Extra classes on the outer ring layer (spacing and width only). |

### Badge

Badge is a compact inline chip for labelling, categorising, or flagging state: a status next to a row, a count, a filter tag, a tier marker.

**Use instead:** For a message that needs a sentence of explanation use Alert, and for an action use Button.

`import { Badge } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/Badge.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/Badge.md) · Story: `Components/Feedback/Badge`

**`BadgeProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tone` | `"neutral"` `"info"` `"success"` `"warning"` `"error"` `"primary"` `"bone"` | `"neutral"` | Colour role. |
| `size` | `"sm"` `"md"` `"lg"` | `"md"` | Badge height: sm 20px, md 24px (default), lg 28px. |
| `caps` | `boolean` | `false` | Uppercase eyebrow voice: uppercase text with .08em tracking. |
| `dashed` | `boolean` | `false` | Not-yet-real voice: transparent fill with a 1px dashed border in the tone's text color, for placeholders, empty slots, and free tiers. |
| `children` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | The label: a word, a short phrase or a number. |
| `iconLeft` | `IconSlot \| ReactNode` |  | Icon before the label, to reinforce the meaning of a status badge. |
| `onDismiss` | `() => void` |  | Adds a remove (x) button that calls this when pressed. |
| `dismissLabel` | `string` |  | Accessible name for the remove button. |
| `className` | `string` | `""` | Extra classes on the badge (margin, alignment). |

### EmptyState

What a view shows when it has nothing to show: a 1-bit icon on a subtle plate, a plain title, a short description, and at most one primary and one secondary Button. `sm` for inline use in cards and tables, `md` for a page or panel.

**Use instead:** content that is still loading (use Skeleton instead, or Spinner for a short wait), or a failure the user has to act on (use Alert instead). Show it only once the result is known to be empty.

`import { EmptyState } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/EmptyState.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/EmptyState.md) · Story: `Components/Feedback/EmptyState`

**`EmptyStateAction`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` (required) | `string` |  | Button text; start with a verb ("Create project"). |
| `onClick` | `() => void` |  | Click handler. |
| `href` | `string` |  | Renders the button as a link instead. |
| `icon` | `IconSlot` | `"Archive"` | Optional icon before the label: a TuiIcon name or an element. |

**`EmptyStateProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `icon` | `IconSlot \| null` | `"Archive"` | Icon shown above the title: a TuiIcon name or an element (default "Archive"). |
| `title` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | Short statement of the situation, e.g. "No results". |
| `description` | `ReactNode` |  | One or two sentences: why it is empty and what to do. |
| `primaryAction` | `EmptyStateAction` |  | The main next step, rendered as a primary Button. |
| `secondaryAction` | `EmptyStateAction` |  | An alternative step (e.g. "Clear filters"), rendered as a secondary Button. |
| `size` | `"sm"` `"md"` | `"md"` | sm for inline use in cards and tables; md (default) for a whole page or panel. |
| `titleAs` | `"h2"` `"h3"` `"h4"` `"p"` | `"h2"` | Heading element for the title, to fit the page outline (default "h2"). |
| `children` | `ReactNode` |  | Extra content under the actions (a help link, a hint). |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes for the root. |

### ProgressBar

Shows task progress.

**Use instead:** a measured value in a known range that is not heading toward completion, such as disk used or a quota (use Meter instead), or a short wait inline or inside a button (use Spinner, or `<Button loading>`, instead).

`import { ProgressBar } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/ProgressBar.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/ProgressBar.md) · Story: `Components/Feedback/ProgressBar`

**`ProgressBarProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `number \| null` |  | Current progress, 0 to `max`. |
| `max` | `number` | `100` | Value that means complete (default 100). |
| `label` (required) | `string` |  | Accessible name, e.g. "Uploading report.pdf". |
| `showLabel` | `boolean` | `true` | Show the label visually (default true). |
| `showValue` | `boolean` | `true` | Show the percentage next to the label for determinate bars (default true). |
| `size` | `"sm"` `"md"` `"lg"` | `"md"` | Track thickness: sm, md (default), lg. |
| `tone` | `"primary"` `"neutral"` `"info"` `"success"` `"warning"` `"error"` | `"primary"` | Fill colour by meaning: primary (the default accent), or a semantic role: neutral, info, success, warning, error. |
| `segments` | `number` | `20` | Number of blocks across the track (default 20, so each block is 5%). |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes for the root (width). |

### Skeleton

Placeholder blocks that hold the layout while content loads.

**Use instead:** a wait where the shape of the coming content is unknown, or a short local wait (use Spinner instead), or a view that has finished loading with nothing to show (use EmptyState instead).

`import { Skeleton } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/Skeleton.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/Skeleton.md) · Story: `Components/Feedback/Skeleton`

**`SkeletonProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `variant` | `"text"` `"rect"` `"avatar"` | `"text"` | Placeholder shape: text lines (default), a rect block, or an avatar square. |
| `lines` | `number` | `1` | Number of text lines for `variant="text"` (default 1). |
| `size` | `"sm"` `"md"` `"lg"` | `"md"` | Avatar square size: sm 32px, md 40px (default), lg 48px (control heights). |
| `animated` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether the stepped pulse runs. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Sizing classes. |

### Spinner

TUI loading indicator in the 1-bit icon language: eight square dots on an 8x8 pixel grid with a two-dot gap that steps clockwise around the ring (100ms per frame).

**Use instead:** a button that is submitting (use `<Button loading>` instead) or work with known progress (use ProgressBar instead).

`import { Spinner } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/Spinner.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/Spinner.md) · Story: `Components/Feedback/Spinner`

**`SpinnerProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `size` | `"sm"` `"md"` `"lg"` | `"md"` | Box size: sm 12px (inline, 32px controls), md 16px (default), lg 24px (48px controls, empty states). |
| `label` | `string` | `"Loading"` | What is loading, read by screen readers and never shown (default "Loading"). |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes for the wrapper, e.g. a text color (`text-[var(--text-secondary)]`). |

### Toast

Toast is a brief, non-blocking confirmation that rises from the bottom edge and goes away on its own: "Copied to clipboard", "+40 XP", "Item deleted (Undo)". `Toaster` is the fixed bottom-center region that renders a queue of toasts.

**Use instead:** Use Alert for errors that need to stay on screen, and Modal for anything the user must read before continuing.

`import { Toast, Toaster } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/Toast.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/Toast.md) · Story: `Components/Feedback/Toast`

**`ToastAction`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` (required) | `string` |  | Short verb shown as the button text ("Undo", "Retry", "View"). |
| `onClick` (required) | `() => void` |  | Runs when the action is pressed; the toast dismisses itself afterwards. |

**`ToastItem`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` (required) | `string \| number` |  | Stable key for the toast (also used by dismissal callbacks). |
| `message` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | Toast content. |
| `tone` | `"neutral"` `"info"` `"success"` `"warning"` `"error"` | `"neutral"` | Severity (default: "neutral"). "error" is announced assertively. |
| `action` | `ToastAction` |  | Optional inline action, such as Undo. |
| `duration` | `number` |  | Milliseconds before auto-dismiss; `Infinity` persists. |

**`ToasterProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `toasts` | `ToastItem[]` |  | Controlled mode: the toasts to render, oldest first (the newest renders closest to the screen edge). |
| `onDismiss` | `(id: ToastItem["id"]) => void` |  | Controlled mode: called when a toast is clicked, its action runs, or its `duration` elapses. |

**`ToastProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `onClick` | `() => void` |  | Called when the plate is clicked (pointer shortcut; wire to dismiss). |
| `tone` | `"neutral"` `"info"` `"success"` `"warning"` `"error"` | `"neutral"` | Severity (default: "neutral"): icon, colors, and `role` (error = alert). |
| `action` | `ToastAction` |  | Optional inline action button, such as Undo. |
| `duration` | `number` |  | Auto-dismiss after this many ms, paused on hover and focus. `Infinity` persists and shows a dismiss button. |
| `onDismiss` | `() => void` |  | Removes the toast (timer, action, or the dismiss button call it). |
| `children` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | Toast content. |

**`ToastOptions`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `ToastItem["id"]` |  | Reuse an id to replace a toast in place (e.g. "Saving..." then "Saved"). |
| `tone` | `"neutral"` `"info"` `"success"` `"warning"` `"error"` | `"neutral"` | Severity (default: "neutral"). |
| `action` | `ToastAction` |  | Optional inline action, such as Undo. |
| `duration` | `number` |  | Milliseconds before auto-dismiss (default 5000); `Infinity` persists. |

**`ToastApi`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `success` (required) | `ShowToast` |  | Queues a success toast (CheckCircle, green). |
| `warning` (required) | `ShowToast` |  | Queues a warning toast (AlertTriangle, purple). |
| `error` (required) | `ShowToast` |  | Queues an error toast (AlertCircle, red), announced with `role="alert"`. |
| `info` (required) | `ShowToast` |  | Queues an info toast (Info, blue). |
| `dismiss` (required) | `(id?: ToastItem["id"]) => void` |  | Removes one toast by id, or every toast when called without one. |

## Inputs

### Checkbox

Checkbox lets users turn an independent option on or off, or pick any number of items from a list, usually as part of a form that is submitted later.

**Use instead:** Use `Switch` instead for settings that take effect immediately, and `Radio` when exactly one option of a set must be chosen.

`import { Checkbox } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/Checkbox.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/Checkbox.md) · Story: `Components/Inputs/Checkbox`

**`CheckboxProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `size` | `"sm"` `"md"` `"lg"` | `"md"` | Box size. |
| `label` | `string \| ReactNode` |  | Visible label; clicking it toggles the box. |
| `error` | `boolean` | `false` | Error styling without a message. |
| `helperText` | `ReactNode` |  | Secondary line under the label (explains the consequence of checking). |
| `errorMessage` | `ReactNode` |  | Validation message under the label. |
| `onCheckedChange` | `(checked: boolean) => void` |  | Called with the new checked state (alternative to `onChange`). |
| `indeterminate` | `boolean` | `false` | Mixed state, for a parent box whose children are partly checked ("select all" over a half-selected list). |

Also accepts the native attributes of `AriaAttributes`, `DOMAttributes`, `HTMLAttributes`, `InputHTMLAttributes`.

### Combobox

Text input with a filtered listbox for choosing one option from a long list.

**Use instead:** a short list the user can scan at a glance (use Select instead), free text with no fixed set of options (use Input instead), or a menu of commands (use Dropdown instead).

`import { Combobox } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/Combobox.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/Combobox.md) · Story: `Components/Inputs/Combobox`

**`ComboboxOption`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` (required) | `string` |  | Value reported through `onValueChange` and the hidden form input. |
| `label` (required) | `string` |  | Text shown in the list and in the field once picked. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Shown but not selectable; skipped by keyboard navigation. |

**`ComboboxProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `string \| null` |  | Controlled selected value (`null` for nothing picked). |
| `label` | `ReactNode` |  | Visible label, wired to the input. |
| `options` (required) | `ComboboxOption[]` |  | Options to filter and choose from. |
| `defaultValue` | `string \| null` | `null` | Initial selected value when uncontrolled. |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: string \| null, option: ComboboxOption \| null) => void` |  | Called with the picked value and option (or `null` when the field is cleared). |
| `onInputChange` | `(query: string) => void` |  | Called on every keystroke with the raw query text. |
| `filter` | `(option: ComboboxOption, query: string) => boolean` | `defaultFilter` | Custom matcher. |
| `emptyText` | `ReactNode` | `"No matches"` | Message shown when nothing matches (default "No matches"). |
| `size` | `"sm"` `"md"` `"lg"` | `"md"` | Field height: sm 32px, md 40px (default), lg 48px. |
| `helperText` | `ReactNode` |  | Hint under the field. |
| `errorMessage` | `ReactNode` |  | Validation message under the field; sets `aria-invalid` and replaces `helperText`. |
| `error` | `boolean` | `false` | Error styling without a message. |
| `openOnFocus` | `boolean` | `false` | Open the list when the field gains focus (default false: opens on typing, click, or arrows). |
| `portal` | `boolean` | `false` | Render the list into `document.body`. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes for the outer wrapper (width). |

Also accepts the native attributes of `AriaAttributes`, `DOMAttributes`, `HTMLAttributes`, `InputHTMLAttributes`.

### Fieldset

Fieldset names a group of related controls: radios that answer one question, a set of checkboxes, or a titled group of settings inside a Card.

**Use instead:** a single control (use that control's own `label` instead), a framed group with a header and footer (use Card instead), a heading over content that is not a set of controls (use a heading element, or Divider with a `label`, instead), or spacing between groups of fields (use Stack instead).

`import { Fieldset } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/Fieldset.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/Fieldset.md) · Story: `Components/Inputs/Fieldset`

**`FieldsetProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `legend` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | The group's name, rendered as the `<legend>` and announced when focus enters the group. |
| `children` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | The controls in the group: Radios sharing one `name`, Checkboxes, Switches or fields. |
| `description` | `ReactNode` |  | One line under the legend that explains the choice. |
| `variant` | `"eyebrow"` `"field"` | `"eyebrow"` | Legend voice. `eyebrow` (default, `text-xs` uppercase) titles a group inside a settings card; `field` matches the Input label and suits a group that asks one question in a form. |
| `gap` | `"none"` `"1"` `"2"` `"3"` `"4"` `"5"` `"6"` `"8"` | `"2"` | Space between the children, on the Stack gap scale: `2` (default) between the options of one choice group, `4` for a group mixing Switch rows and Checkboxes. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables every control in the group natively (the browser disables each descendant input and button) and dims the controls but not the legend, as Input dims its field but not its label. |
| `error` | `boolean` | `false` | Group-level error without a message. |
| `errorMessage` | `ReactNode` |  | Group-level validation message under the controls ("Pick a plan"), linked with `aria-describedby`. |
| `role` | `"group"` `"radiogroup"` |  | `radiogroup` for a set of Radios: it is the role that can carry the group's invalid state (decision 0029, `Radio.md`). |
| `className` | `string` |  | Layout classes for the fieldset itself (width, margin). |

Also accepts the native attributes of `AriaAttributes`, `DOMAttributes`, `FieldsetHTMLAttributes`, `HTMLAttributes`.

### Input

Input is the single-line text field for short free-form values: names, emails, search terms, codes.

**Use instead:** For multi-line text use `Textarea`; for a fixed set of choices use `Select`, `Radio`, or `Checkbox`; for a numeric range use `Slider`.

`import { Input } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/Input.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/Input.md) · Story: `Components/Inputs/Input`

**`InputTrailingAction`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `icon` (required) | `IconSlot` |  | The icon: a TuiIcon name (`"Eye"`) or an element. |
| `label` (required) | `string` |  | Accessible name of the button, read by screen readers and required: the button shows only an icon. |
| `onClick` (required) | `(event: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => void` |  | Called when the button is clicked or activated with Enter or Space. |
| `pressed` | `boolean` |  | Makes the action a toggle button: sets `aria-pressed`, so assistive tech announces "pressed" or "not pressed". |

**`InputProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `ReactNode` |  | Optional visible label. |
| `size` | `"sm"` `"md"` `"lg"` | `"md"` | Field height: sm 32px, md 40px (default), lg 48px. |
| `variant` | `"box"` `"quiet"` | `"box"` | Visual variant. "box" (default) is the plate field; "quiet" is the underline recipe: transparent, bottom hairline only, the site's voice for inline fields (passwords, rename-in-place). |
| `error` | `boolean` | `false` | Error styling without a message. |
| `helperText` | `ReactNode` |  | Hint shown under the field (format, constraints). |
| `errorMessage` | `ReactNode` |  | Validation message shown under the field. |
| `trailingAction` | `InputTrailingAction` |  | One icon button inside the end of the field, such as a password reveal (`{ icon: visible ? "EyeOff" : "Eye", label: "Show password", pressed: visible, onClick: toggle }`). |

Also accepts the native attributes of `AriaAttributes`, `DOMAttributes`, `HTMLAttributes`, `InputHTMLAttributes`.

### Radio

Radio lets users choose exactly one option from a small, visible set (roughly two to five).

**Use instead:** Use `Select` when the list is long or space is tight, and `Checkbox` when several options can be on at once.

`import { Radio } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/Radio.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/Radio.md) · Story: `Components/Inputs/Radio`

**`RadioProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `size` | `"sm"` `"md"` `"lg"` | `"md"` | Box size: sm 16px, md 20px (default), lg 24px. |
| `label` | `string \| ReactNode` |  | Visible label next to the box; clicking it selects the radio. |
| `error` | `boolean` | `false` | Error styling without a message. |
| `helperText` | `ReactNode` |  | Secondary line under the label (explains what picking this option means). |
| `errorMessage` | `ReactNode` |  | Validation message under the label, read through `aria-describedby`. |
| `onCheckedChange` | `(checked: boolean) => void` |  | Called with this radio's checked state after a change (alternative to `onChange`). |

Also accepts the native attributes of `AriaAttributes`, `DOMAttributes`, `HTMLAttributes`, `InputHTMLAttributes`.

### Select

Select picks one value from a list of options inside a form.

**Use instead:** For a menu of actions rather than a value, use `Dropdown`; for two to four visible choices, use `Radio`.

`import { Select } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/Select.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/Select.md) · Story: `Components/Inputs/Select`

**`SelectProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `ReactNode` |  | Optional visible label; associates with the custom trigger (the combobox) via `htmlFor` / `id`. |
| `size` | `"sm"` `"md"` `"lg"` | `"md"` | Trigger height: sm 32px, md 40px (default), lg 48px. |
| `error` | `boolean` | `false` | Error styling without a message. |
| `helperText` | `ReactNode` |  | Hint shown under the trigger. |
| `errorMessage` | `ReactNode` |  | Validation message shown under the trigger. |

Also accepts the native attributes of `AriaAttributes`, `DOMAttributes`, `HTMLAttributes`, `SelectHTMLAttributes`.

### Slider

Slider picks a numeric value from a continuous or stepped range, such as zoom level, size, or bias, where the relative position matters more than typing an exact number.

**Use instead:** Use `Input type="number"` when users need to enter a precise value, and `Select` or `Radio` for a handful of named choices.

`import { Slider } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/Slider.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/Slider.md) · Story: `Components/Inputs/Slider`

**`SliderProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `ReactNode` |  | Visible label tied to the input with htmlFor/id; one of `label`, `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` is required. |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  | Accessible name when the slider has no visible label of its own (a zoom slider in a toolbar). |
| `aria-labelledby` | `string` |  | Id of visible text elsewhere that names the slider, such as a column heading. |

Also accepts the native attributes of `AriaAttributes`, `DOMAttributes`, `HTMLAttributes`, `InputHTMLAttributes`.

### Switch

Switch toggles a setting on or off with an immediate effect, like enabling notifications or a theme.

**Use instead:** Use `Checkbox` instead when the choice is part of a form that is submitted later.

`import { Switch } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/Switch.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/Switch.md) · Story: `Components/Inputs/Switch`

**`SwitchProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `checked` | `boolean` |  | Whether the switch is on, for a controlled switch: keep it in state and update it from `onCheckedChange`. |
| `defaultChecked` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether an uncontrolled switch starts on. |
| `onCheckedChange` | `(checked: boolean) => void` |  | Called with the next value when the user clicks the track or label, or presses Space or Enter. |
| `size` | `"sm"` `"md"` `"lg"` | `"md"` | Track size. |
| `label` | `string` |  | Visible label and accessible name; one of `label`, `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` is required. |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  | Accessible name when there is no `label` (a theme toggle whose state is shown by an icon). |
| `aria-labelledby` | `string` |  | Id of visible text elsewhere that names the switch, such as a settings row heading. |
| `hideLabel` | `boolean` | `false` | Keep `label` as the accessible name only (no visible text). |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Blocks interaction and dims the switch. |
| `icon` | `IconSlot \| ReactNode` |  | Icon drawn inside the knob, for a switch whose two states have a picture (a moon and sun for the theme toggle). |

Also accepts the native attributes of `AriaAttributes`, `ButtonHTMLAttributes`, `DOMAttributes`, `HTMLAttributes`.

### Textarea

Textarea is the multi-line text field for longer free-form input: notes, feedback, descriptions.

**Use instead:** Use `Input` for single-line values; use Textarea whenever the answer may wrap or contain line breaks.

`import { Textarea } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/Textarea.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/Textarea.md) · Story: `Components/Inputs/Textarea`

**`TextareaProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `size` | `"sm"` `"md"` `"lg"` | `"md"` | Minimum height and padding: sm, md (default), lg, matching Input. |
| `error` | `boolean` | `false` | Error styling without a message. |
| `helperText` | `ReactNode` |  | Hint shown under the field (length, format). |
| `errorMessage` | `ReactNode` |  | Validation message shown under the field. |
| `label` | `ReactNode` |  | Optional visible label. |

Also accepts the native attributes of `AriaAttributes`, `DOMAttributes`, `HTMLAttributes`, `TextareaHTMLAttributes`.

## Layout

### Box

Box is the base surface primitive: token-backed padding, a semantic background, and the optional hairline plate ring, on the element of your choice.

**Use instead:** grouped content with a header or footer on a raised surface (use Card instead) or a framed terminal pane with a title bar (use Window instead).

`import { Box } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/Box.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/Box.md) · Story: `Primitives/Layout/Box`

**`BoxProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` | `ReactNode` |  | Content to sit inside the padding and on top of the background. |
| `padding` | `"none"` `"1"` `"2"` `"3"` `"4"` `"5"` `"6"` `"8"` |  | Padding on all four sides, from the spacing scale: `none` 0, `1` 4px, `2` 8px, `3` 12px, `4` 16px, `5` 20px, `6` 24px, `8` 32px. |
| `paddingX` | `"none"` `"1"` `"2"` `"3"` `"4"` `"5"` `"6"` `"8"` |  | Left/right inset when it differs from the vertical one; replaces `padding` on that axis. |
| `paddingY` | `"none"` `"1"` `"2"` `"3"` `"4"` `"5"` `"6"` `"8"` |  | Top/bottom inset when it differs from the horizontal one; replaces `padding` on that axis. |
| `background` | `"none"` `"page"` `"container"` `"card"` `"subtle"` `"muted"` `"raised"` `"inverse"` | `"none"` | Semantic surface to paint behind the content. `card` sits on top of `container`, `container` sits on `page`; `inverse` also flips the text color so content stays readable. |
| `border` | `"none"` `"hairline"` | `"none"` | `hairline` wraps the content in the plate ring (outer stroke layer plus a 1px-inset fill layer) because `clip-path` would slice a real CSS border. |
| `as` | `"div"` `"section"` `"article"` `"aside"` `"header"` `"footer"` `"main"` `"nav"` `"figure"` `"li"` `"span"` | `"div"` | Element to render when the Box is a landmark or a list item rather than a generic grouping (`section`, `nav`, `li`, ...). |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes (width, height, position), merged with `cn()` so they beat the generated ones. |

Also accepts the native attributes of `AriaAttributes`, `DOMAttributes`, `HTMLAttributes`.

### Center

Center puts one column of content in the middle of its parent: a measured width, optionally centered text, and optionally the full viewport height.

**Use instead:** page width and gutters (use Container instead) or the vertical rhythm inside the column (use Stack instead).

`import { Center } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/Center.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/Center.md) · Story: `Primitives/Layout/Center`

**`CenterProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | Content to center; it keeps its own layout inside the column. |
| `maxWidth` | `"xs"` `"sm"` `"md"` `"lg"` `"xl"` `"2xl"` `"none"` | `"md"` | Width of the centered column: `xs` 320px, `sm` 384px, `md` 448px (default, about the width of a sign-in card), `lg` 512px, `xl` 576px, `2xl` 672px, `none` to center a block that sizes itself. |
| `andText` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether to center the text as well as the box. |
| `fullHeight` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether to also center vertically in the viewport, for a splash, sign-in or error screen that owns the whole page. |
| `as` | `"div"` `"section"` `"article"` `"main"` `"figure"` | `"div"` | Element to render, so a centered block can be a `section` or the page `main` instead of a `div`. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes (padding, background), merged with `cn()` so they win. |

Also accepts the native attributes of `AriaAttributes`, `DOMAttributes`, `HTMLAttributes`.

### Container

Container is the page-width wrapper: one max width, one set of gutters, one place to change either.

**Use instead:** a background band (wrap the Container in a Box instead), vertical rhythm (use Stack instead) or a single centred column (use Center instead).

`import { Container } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/Container.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/Container.md) · Story: `Primitives/Layout/Container`

**`ContainerProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | Page content; centered inside the max width and inset by the gutters. |
| `size` | `"sm"` `"md"` `"lg"` `"xl"` `"full"` | `"lg"` | Where the content stops growing: `sm` 640px, `md` 768px, `lg` 1024px (default, the reading width for most pages), `xl` 1280px, `full` no limit. |
| `gutter` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether to inset the content from the viewport edges (20px, 40px from `lg` up). |
| `as` | `"div"` `"main"` `"section"` `"article"` `"header"` `"footer"` `"nav"` `"aside"` | `"div"` | Element to render, so the page wrapper can be the real landmark (`main`, `header`, `footer`, `nav`) instead of a `div`. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes (vertical padding, background), merged with `cn()` so they win. |

Also accepts the native attributes of `AriaAttributes`, `DOMAttributes`, `HTMLAttributes`.

### Grid

Grid is the two-dimensional layout primitive: a token-backed gap and a column count that can change per breakpoint.

**Use instead:** a single column or a single wrapping row (use Stack or Inline instead) or tabular data with headers (use Table instead).

`import { Grid } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/Grid.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/Grid.md) · Story: `Primitives/Layout/Grid`

**`GridProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | Cells to place in the tracks; each child fills one cell in source order. |
| `columns` | `GridColumns` | `1` | Track count. |
| `gap` | `"none"` `"1"` `"2"` `"3"` `"4"` `"5"` `"6"` `"8"` | `"4"` | Space between all tracks, from the spacing scale: `none` 0, `1` 4px, `2` 8px, `3` 12px, `4` 16px (default), `5` 20px, `6` 24px, `8` 32px. |
| `rowGap` | `"none"` `"1"` `"2"` `"3"` `"4"` `"5"` `"6"` `"8"` |  | Space between rows when it differs from `gap`, for example a tight grid with airy rows. |
| `columnGap` | `"none"` `"1"` `"2"` `"3"` `"4"` `"5"` `"6"` `"8"` |  | Space between columns when it differs from `gap`. |
| `align` | `"start"` `"center"` `"end"` `"stretch"` | `"stretch"` | How cells sit vertically in their row. `stretch` (default) gives every card in a row the height of the tallest one; `start` lets them keep their own height. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes (width, padding, explicit row definitions), merged with `cn()` so they win. |

Also accepts the native attributes of `AriaAttributes`, `DOMAttributes`, `HTMLAttributes`.

### Inline

Inline is the horizontal cluster: a row of items that wraps onto the next line instead of overflowing.

**Use instead:** For a column use Stack; for items that must line up across rows as well as along them use Grid.

`import { Inline } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/Inline.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/Inline.md) · Story: `Primitives/Layout/Inline`

**`InlineProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | Items to place side by side; they keep their own width and wrap as a unit. |
| `gap` | `"none"` `"1"` `"2"` `"3"` `"4"` `"5"` `"6"` `"8"` | `"2"` | Space between items, used for both the row gap and the wrap gap, from the spacing scale: `none` 0, `1` 4px, `2` 8px (default), `3` 12px, `4` 16px, `5` 20px, `6` 24px, `8` 32px. |
| `align` | `"start"` `"center"` `"end"` `"baseline"` | `"center"` | How items line up across the row. `center` (default) suits controls of mixed height; `baseline` lines up the text in a label plus value meta row. |
| `justify` | `"start"` `"center"` `"end"` `"between"` | `"start"` | How leftover horizontal space is distributed. `start` (default) keeps the cluster tight; `between` pushes the first and last item to the edges of a full-width row such as a toolbar. |
| `wrap` | `boolean` | `true` | Whether items flow onto a new line when the row runs out of width. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes (width, padding, self-alignment), merged with `cn()` so they win. |

Also accepts the native attributes of `AriaAttributes`, `DOMAttributes`, `HTMLAttributes`.

### Stack

Stack is the layout primitive for spacing a group of elements along one axis with a gap from the spacing scale.

**Use instead:** a row of items that should wrap (use Inline instead) or a two-dimensional layout (use Grid instead).

`import { Stack } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/Stack.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/Stack.md) · Story: `Primitives/Layout/Stack`

**`StackProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | Stack contents; laid out along `axis` with `gap` between them. |
| `gap` | `"none"` `"1"` `"2"` `"3"` `"4"` `"5"` `"6"` `"8"` | `"4"` | Maps to the spacing scale (`gap-*` utilities): `none` 0, `1` 4px, `2` 8px, `3` 12px, `4` 16px (default), `5` 20px, `6` 24px, `8` 32px. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Additional CSS classes (width, padding, alignment overrides). |
| `axis` | `StackAxis` | `"vertical"` | Layout direction: `"vertical"` (default, a column), `"horizontal"` (a row that wraps and centres its children), or a breakpoint map such as `{ base: "vertical", md: "horizontal" }` (keys `base`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`, `xl`; `base` required). |
| `align` | `"start"` `"center"` `"end"` `"stretch"` |  | Cross-axis placement of children at every breakpoint; unset, a column stretches them and a row centres them. |

Also accepts the native attributes of `AriaAttributes`, `DOMAttributes`, `HTMLAttributes`.

### VisuallyHidden

VisuallyHidden renders content that screen readers announce and nobody sees: the word "Close" in an icon button, a caption for a table, the "Skip to content" link at the top of a page.

**Use instead:** naming an element that already takes a name, such as an icon Button (use `aria-label` instead), or content nobody should perceive (use `aria-hidden` or do not render it instead).

`import { VisuallyHidden } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/VisuallyHidden.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/VisuallyHidden.md) · Story: `Primitives/Layout/VisuallyHidden`

**`VisuallyHiddenProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | Text or markup to announce. |
| `focusable` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the content shows itself once anything inside it takes focus. |
| `as` | `"span"` `"div"` `"p"` `"label"` `"legend"` `"li"` | `"span"` | Element to render, when the hidden text is a `label` for a control or a `li` inside a list rather than a generic `span`. |
| `htmlFor` | `string` |  | With `as="label"`, the `id` of the control this labels. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes (placement for the focusable variant), merged with `cn()` so they win. |

Also accepts the native attributes of `AriaAttributes`, `DOMAttributes`, `HTMLAttributes`.

## Navigation

### AppHeader

The application top bar: a `<header>` with `brand`, `navigation`, and `actions` slots.

**Use instead:** section navigation down the side of a page (use SideNav instead), a trail showing where the current page sits (use Breadcrumbs instead), or the bottom bar of a terminal-style app (use StatusLine instead). Render one per app.

`import { AppHeader } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/AppHeader.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/AppHeader.md) · Story: `Components/Navigation/AppHeader`

**`AppHeaderProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `brand` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | Left slot: logo, product name, or a home link. |
| `navigation` | `ReactNode` |  | Middle slot: primary navigation links. |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` |  | Right slot: actions such as ThemeToggle, search, or an Avatar menu. |
| `mobileMenu` | `ReactNode` |  | Content of the mobile menu panel. |
| `sticky` | `boolean` | `false` | Pin the bar to the top of its scroll container (z-index.sticky). |
| `menuOpen` | `boolean` |  | Mobile menu open state (controlled). |
| `defaultMenuOpen` | `boolean` | `false` | Initial mobile menu state when uncontrolled (default closed). |
| `onMenuOpenChange` | `(open: boolean) => void` |  | Fires when the menu toggle opens or closes the mobile panel. |
| `menuLabel` | `string` | `"Menu"` | Accessible name of the menu toggle (default "Menu"). |
| `navLabel` | `string` | `"Main"` | Accessible name of the navigation landmark (default "Main"). |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes for the `<header>`. |

### Breadcrumbs

Shows where the current page sits in a hierarchy: a `<nav aria-label="Breadcrumb">` landmark around an ordered list of links, ending on the current page (plain text with `aria-current="page"`).

**Use instead:** step progress (use a stepper) or tabs between sibling views (use Tabs).

`import { Breadcrumbs } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/Breadcrumbs.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/Breadcrumbs.md) · Story: `Components/Navigation/Breadcrumbs`

**`BreadcrumbItem`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | Visible text for this step. |
| `href` | `string` |  | Destination for ancestor steps. |
| `as` | `ElementType` |  | Custom link component (e.g. a router `<Link>`) used instead of `<a href>`. |
| `asProps` | `Record<string, unknown>` |  | Props for the `as` component (`to`, `state`, ...), spread onto it as-is. |
| `key` | `string` |  | Stable React key. |

**`BreadcrumbsProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` (required) | `BreadcrumbItem[]` |  | Trail from the root to the current page (last item = current page). |
| `maxItems` | `number` |  | Collapse the middle of the trail once it has more than this many items. |
| `itemsBeforeCollapse` | `number` | `1` | Items kept visible before the overflow button when collapsed (default 1). |
| `itemsAfterCollapse` | `number` | `1` | Items kept visible after the overflow button when collapsed (default 1). |
| `expandLabel` | `(hiddenCount: number) => string` | `(n) => `Show ${n} more breadcrumb${n === 1 ? "" : "s"}`` | Accessible name for the overflow button; receives the hidden count. |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the nav landmark (default "Breadcrumb"). |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes for the `<nav>`. |

### Link

Link is the inline text link for navigation inside prose, captions, nav lists and footers.

**Use instead:** When a navigation needs to look like a plate-shaped call to action, use `Button` with `href` instead; when the action happens in place ("Show more", "Open dialog"), use `Button`.

`import { Link } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/Link.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/Link.md) · Story: `Components/Navigation/Link`

**`LinkProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `variant` | `"inline"` `"quiet"` | `"inline"` | Visual treatment. `inline` (default) keeps a persistent underline so the link reads inside body text without relying on color alone; `quiet` underlines only on hover/focus, for nav lists and footers where position already signals the link. |
| `external` | `boolean` | `false` | Marks an external destination: opens in a new tab (`target="_blank"`, `rel="noopener noreferrer"`, both overridable), appends the ExternalLink glyph, and announces "(opens in new tab)" to screen readers. |
| `className` | `string` | `""` | Additional CSS classes (size, margin, color overrides). |
| `children` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | Link text. |
| `href` | `string` |  | Destination URL. |
| `as` | `never` |  |  |
| `asProps` | `never` |  |  |

### Pagination

Page picker for long, paged collections.

**Use instead:** switching between a few peer views (use Tabs instead) or a feed that loads more in place (use a Button at the end of the list instead).

`import { Pagination } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/Pagination.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/Pagination.md) · Story: `Components/Navigation/Pagination`

**`PaginationProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `page` | `number` |  | Current page, 1-based (controlled). |
| `pageCount` (required) | `number` |  | Total number of pages. |
| `defaultPage` | `number` | `1` | Starting page when uncontrolled (default 1). |
| `onPageChange` | `(page: number) => void` |  | Fires with the requested 1-based page when the user picks a page or steps prev/next. |
| `siblingCount` | `number` | `1` | Pages shown on each side of the current page (default 1). |
| `boundaryCount` | `number` | `1` | Pages always shown at the start and end (default 1). |
| `size` | `"sm"` `"md"` `"lg"` | `"md"` | Plate height from the Button scale: sm 32px, md 40px (default), lg 48px. |
| `showPrevNext` | `boolean` | `true` | Show the previous/next arrow buttons (default true). |
| `getPageLabel` | `(page: number) => string` | `(p) => `Page ${p}`` | Accessible name of each page button (default "Page 3"). |
| `previousLabel` | `string` | `"Previous page"` | Accessible name of the previous button (default "Previous page"). |
| `nextLabel` | `string` | `"Next page"` | Accessible name of the next button (default "Next page"). |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the nav landmark (default "Pagination"). |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes for the `<nav>`. |

### SideNav

The Patterns/SideNavigation recipe as a compound component: `SideNav` > `SideNavSection` (optional heading naming a group) > `SideNavItem`.

**Use instead:** the app's top bar (use AppHeader instead), switching between views inside one page (use Tabs instead), or a nested data hierarchy such as files (use TreeView instead).

`import { SideNav, SideNavSection, SideNavItem } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/SideNav.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/SideNav.md) · Story: `Components/Navigation/SideNav`

**`SideNavProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `aria-label` | `string` |  | Accessible name for the nav landmark, e.g. "Primary". |
| `collapsed` | `boolean` | `false` | Icon-only rail: labels become accessible names plus tooltips. |
| `children` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | SideNavSection and/or SideNavItem children. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes for the `<nav>` (width, height, borders). |

**`SideNavSectionProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | SideNavItem rows. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes for the section wrapper. |
| `heading` | `ReactNode` |  | Optional section heading. |

**`SideNavItemProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` | `ReactNode` |  | Nested SideNavItem rows. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes for the row element. |
| `label` (required) | `string` |  | Row text. |
| `icon` | `IconSlot` |  | Icon shown before the label, a TuiIcon name or an element (strongly recommended; required for a useful collapsed rail). |
| `active` | `boolean` | `false` | Marks the current route: holds the hover fill and sets `aria-current="page"`. |
| `href` | `string` |  | Destination; renders an `<a>`. |
| `onClick` | `(event: MouseEvent<HTMLElement>) => void` |  | Click handler. |
| `as` | `ElementType` |  | Custom link component (e.g. a router `<Link>`); its props go in `asProps`. |
| `asProps` | `Record<string, unknown>` |  | Props for the `as` component (`to`, `state`, ...), spread onto it as-is. |
| `trailing` | `ReactNode` |  | Trailing content at the row end (a count Badge, a Kbd hint). |
| `expanded` | `boolean` |  | Group open state (controlled). |
| `defaultExpanded` | `boolean` |  | Initial group open state. |
| `onExpandedChange` | `(expanded: boolean) => void` |  | Fires when a group row toggles. |

### Tabs

Tabs switch between related views that share one context, such as the sections of a settings screen, without leaving the page.

**Use instead:** For navigation between pages use `Link` or a nav list of `ListRow`s, and for a single show/hide choice use `Switch` or a disclosure.

`import { Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/Tabs.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/Tabs.md) · Story: `Components/Navigation/Tabs`

**`TabsProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `string` |  | Selected panel id (controlled). |
| `onValueChange` | `(value: string) => void` |  | Fires when the active tab changes. |
| `defaultValue` | `string` |  | Initial panel when uncontrolled; use `undefined` to auto-select the first tab. |
| `children` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | One `TabsList` followed by a `TabsContent` for each trigger. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes on the wrapper (width, spacing between the strip and panels). |

**`TabsListProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `children` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | The `TabsTrigger` buttons, in the order the arrow keys move through them. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes on the tab strip (alignment, overflow). |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  | Accessible name for the tab strip, such as "Account sections"; this or `aria-labelledby` is required. |
| `aria-labelledby` | `string` |  | Id of a visible heading that names the tab strip; use it instead of `aria-label` when such a heading exists. |

**`TabsContentProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` (required) | `string` |  | Id of this panel; the `TabsTrigger` with the same `value` opens it. |
| `children` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | The panel's content, shown while its tab is selected. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes on the panel (padding, a min-height so the layout does not jump between tabs). |
| `forceMount` | `boolean` | `false` | Keep inactive panels mounted (hidden) so form state is preserved. |

## Overlays

### BottomSheet

BottomSheet is a panel that slides up from the bottom edge over a scrim, for menus and quick actions that dismiss easily: a site menu on mobile, a short list of options, a share sheet.

**Use instead:** Use Modal for blocking confirmations or tasks with explicit actions, and keep persistent navigation in the page rather than a sheet.

`import { BottomSheet } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/BottomSheet.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/BottomSheet.md) · Story: `Components/Overlays/BottomSheet`

**`BottomSheetProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `open` | `boolean` |  | Whether the sheet is shown. |
| `defaultOpen` | `boolean` | `false` | Initial open state when `open` is not passed (default false). |
| `onOpenChange` | `(open: boolean) => void` |  | Called with `false` when the user dismisses the sheet (close button, scrim click or Escape). |
| `closeLabel` | `string` | `"Close"` | Accessible name for the close button. |
| `children` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | Sheet content. |
| `aria-label` (required) | `string` |  | Accessible name announced for the sheet dialog, e.g. "Site menu". |

### Dropdown

Dropdown is an action menu: a trigger that opens a short list of commands such as Edit, Duplicate, or Delete.

**Use instead:** To choose a form value use `Select`; for navigation between views use `Tabs` or `Link`.

`import { Dropdown } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/Dropdown.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/Dropdown.md) · Story: `Components/Overlays/Dropdown`

**`DropdownItem`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` (required) | `string` | `"Actions"` | Item text and accessible name. |
| `onClick` (required) | `() => void` |  | Called on activation; the menu then closes. |
| `icon` | `IconSlot \| ReactNode` |  | Left icon grouped with the label. |
| `iconRight` | `IconSlot \| ReactNode` |  | Right-aligned icon, for a shortcut hint or an external-link marker. |
| `variant` | `"default"` `"destructive"` |  | `destructive` colors the item red for irreversible actions. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  | Dims the item, blocks activation, and skips it during arrow-key navigation. |

**`DropdownProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `string` | `"Actions"` | Text (and accessible name) of the default trigger button. |
| `trigger` | `ReactNode` |  | Custom trigger, replacing the default button. |
| `items` (required) | `DropdownItem[]` |  | Menu entries, in order. |
| `align` | `"start"` `"end"` | `"start"` | Which trigger edge the menu lines up with (default "start", the leading edge). |
| `size` | `"sm"` `"md"` `"lg"` | `"md"` | Trigger height, matching Button/Input: sm, md (default), lg. |

### Modal

Modal is a centered dialog over a scrim that interrupts the page for a task or decision the user must finish or dismiss before going back: confirmations, short forms, reward claims.

**Use instead:** Use BottomSheet for light menus and quick actions, Alert for inline messages, and Toast for passive confirmations.

`import { Modal } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/Modal.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/Modal.md) · Story: `Components/Overlays/Modal`

**`ModalProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `open` | `boolean` |  | Whether the dialog is shown. |
| `defaultOpen` | `boolean` | `false` | Initial open state when `open` is not passed (default false). |
| `onOpenChange` | `(open: boolean) => void` |  | Called with `false` when the user asks to close (close button, Escape, or a scrim click). |
| `title` (required) | `string` |  | Heading in the fixed header; also the dialog's accessible name, so make it say what the dialog is for. |
| `children` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | Body content. |
| `footerContent` | `ReactNode` |  | Optional fixed footer for CTAs. |
| `size` | `"xs"` `"sm"` `"md"` `"lg"` `"xl"` `"full"` |  | Panel width: `xs` (320px) for a one-line notice or reward, `sm` (360px) for a confirmation, `md` (440px) for a picker or short form, `lg` (640px) for a compare card or a form with sections, `xl` (740px, the default when no `size` is passed) for a full task, `full` for the whole viewport width. |
| `docked` | `boolean` | `false` | Dock instead of covering: at or above the `--breakpoint-docked` token (960px) the panel pins bottom-center with no scrim and no scroll lock (a non-modal dialog), keeping the page behind visible and interactive. |

### Popover

Anchored, non-modal floating panel for rich interactive content next to a trigger (filters, a small form, a details card).

**Use instead:** short hints (Tooltip), action lists (Dropdown), blocking tasks (Modal).

`import { Popover } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/Popover.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/Popover.md) · Story: `Components/Overlays/Popover`

**`PopoverProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `open` | `boolean` |  | Controlled open state. |
| `defaultOpen` | `boolean` | `false` | Initial open state when uncontrolled (default false). |
| `onOpenChange` | `(open: boolean) => void` |  | Called whenever the popover asks to open or close (trigger, Escape, outside click, blur). |
| `trigger` | `ReactElement` |  | The element that toggles the popover, usually a `Button`. |
| `anchorRef` | `RefObject<HTMLElement \| null>` |  | Position against an element you render yourself instead of `trigger` (e.g. an input). |
| `children` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | Panel content. |
| `side` | `"top"` `"bottom"` `"left"` `"right"` | `"bottom"` | Preferred side of the anchor (default "bottom"). |
| `align` | `"start"` `"center"` `"end"` | `"start"` | Alignment along the anchor edge (default "start"). |
| `offset` | `number` | `8` | Gap between anchor and panel, in px (default 8, one plate step multiple). |
| `closeOnOutsideClick` | `boolean` | `true` | Close when the user presses outside the trigger and panel (default true). |
| `closeOnEscape` | `boolean` | `true` | Close on Escape (default true). |
| `autoFocus` | `boolean` | `true` | Move focus into the panel on open: the first focusable element, else the panel itself (default true). |
| `returnFocus` | `boolean` | `true` | Send focus back to the trigger when closed via Escape or the trigger (default true). |
| `matchAnchorWidth` | `boolean` | `false` | Make the panel at least as wide as the anchor (default false). |
| `id` | `string` |  | Id for the panel; generated when omitted. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes for the outer ring layer (width, max-width). |
| `contentClassName` | `string` |  | Extra classes for the inner fill (padding, layout). |
| `portal` | `boolean` | `false` | Render the panel into `document.body` (default false). |
| `triggerWrapperClassName` | `string` |  | Extra classes for the span that wraps `trigger`. |
| `role` | `Exclude<NamedRole<AriaRole>, "dialog"> \| null` | `"dialog"` | ARIA role of the panel: "dialog" (the default, a non-modal dialog), any other ARIA role, or `null`. |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  | Accessible name for the panel. |
| `aria-labelledby` | `string` |  | Id of a visible heading inside the panel that names it. |

### Tooltip

Tooltip shows a short supplementary hint next to a trigger when it is hovered or focused, most often to name an icon-only button or add a detail to a label.

**Use instead:** content with a link, a button or more than a sentence (use Popover instead) or a hint that must always be visible (use helper text on the field instead).

`import { Tooltip } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/Tooltip.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/Tooltip.md) · Story: `Components/Overlays/Tooltip`

**`TooltipProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `content` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | Short supplementary hint. |
| `children` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | The trigger. |
| `side` | `"top"` `"right"` `"bottom"` `"left"` | `"top"` | Preferred side of the trigger (default "top"). |
| `align` | `"start"` `"center"` `"end"` | `"center"` | Where the balloon sits along the trigger edge (default "center"). `start` and `end` line its leading or trailing edge up with the trigger's, for a trigger at the edge of a row; the caret still points at the trigger. |
| `delay` | `number` | `200` | Delay in milliseconds before showing on hover or focus (default 200). |
| `maxWidth` | `string` | `"200px"` | Max width of the balloon, any CSS length (default "200px"); text wraps inside it. |
| `className` | `string` | `""` | Extra classes for the wrapper (e.g. a width class for a full-width trigger). |

## Patterns

### CaseStudy

CaseStudy renders long-form narrative pages (case studies, write-ups, project pages) from data.

**Use instead:** a landing page or any page that is not a narrative write-up (compose Container, Stack and Card instead).

`import { CaseStudyContent, CaseStudyHeader, CaseStudySections, CaseStudyPage } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/CaseStudy.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/CaseStudy.md) · Story: `Patterns/CaseStudy (full pages: Screens/CaseStudyTemplate)`

**`CaseStudyItem`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` (required) | `string` |  | Short heading for the item: a step name, a finding, a pillar. |
| `text` (required) | `string` |  | One or two sentences under the title explaining it. |

**`CaseStudyOutcome`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` (required) | `string` |  | The figure itself, set large in the accent colour ("43", "2x", "-60%"). |
| `label` (required) | `string` |  | What the figure counts, in a few words ("components shipped"). |

**`CaseStudyFigure`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `src` | `string` |  | Image URL. |
| `alt` | `string` |  | Empty string (the default) marks the image decorative. |
| `aspect` | `"16 / 9"` `"21 / 9"` `"4 / 3"` |  | Shape of the frame, as a CSS aspect-ratio: `16 / 9` (default) for most art, `21 / 9` for a wide diagram (pair it with `width="wide"`), `4 / 3` for a screenshot or the shape an image pair uses. |
| `caption` | `string` |  | Text under the figure; inside a section it is prefixed with the figure number. |
| `width` | `"wide"` `"full"` |  | Break out of the text column: `wide` or `full` bleed. |

**`CaseStudySection`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` (required) | `string` |  | The section's heading, a sentence that states its point. |
| `kicker` (required) | `string` |  | Short section name shown in the rule: "the problem". |
| `intro` | `string` |  | Optional lead paragraph under the title. |
| `blocks` | `CaseStudyContentBlock[]` |  | Content in reading order. |
| `hidden` | `boolean` |  | Leave the section out of the page (and out of the numbering). |
| `id` | `string` |  | Anchor id. |

**`CaseStudy`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` (required) | `string` |  | The page title, the largest type on the page. |
| `summary` (required) | `string` |  | One line: what this was and what it achieved. |
| `outcomes` | `CaseStudyOutcome[]` |  | Headline results, shown as accent figures in the header. |
| `meta` | `{ label: string; value: string; }[]` |  | Label and value rows in the header: role, team, timeline, year. |
| `cover` | `CaseStudyFigure` |  | Cover image under the header. |
| `sections` (required) | `CaseStudySection[]` |  | The body, in reading order; reorder by moving entries and hide one with `hidden`. |

## Terminal

### CodeBlock

CodeBlock shows read-only code: a snippet in a chat reply, the generated source of a layout, a config file.

**Use instead:** output that streams in line by line, such as build or server logs (use `LogView` instead), a key or shortcut inside a sentence (use `Kbd` instead), or a terminal pane with its own title and actions around other content (use `Window` instead, with an unframed CodeBlock inside if it holds code).

`import { CodeBlock } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/CodeBlock.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/CodeBlock.md) · Story: `Components/Terminal/CodeBlock`

**`CodeBlockProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `code` (required) | `string` |  | The code, as one string with `\n` line breaks. |
| `language` | `string` |  | Language name ("tsx", "json"). |
| `title` | `ReactNode` |  | Title bar text, usually the file name ("settings-screen.tsx"). |
| `showLineNumbers` | `boolean` | `false` | Show a gutter of 1-based line numbers (default false), for code people will discuss by line. |
| `highlightLines` | `number[]` |  | 1-based lines to mark with a muted row and a gutter marker (never color alone), for the lines an answer is about. |
| `wrap` | `boolean` | `false` | Wrap long lines instead of scrolling horizontally (default false). |
| `copyable` | `boolean` | `true` | Show the copy button (default true). |
| `onCopy` | `(code: string) => void` |  | Fires with the code after a successful copy, for analytics or a toast. |
| `framed` | `boolean` | `true` | Draw the plate ring (default true). |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the block. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes for the figure. |

### DescriptionList

Term and value pairs on a real `<dl>`: metadata panels, config readouts, neofetch-style summaries.

**Use instead:** several records that share the same columns (use Table instead) or a list of items people open or act on (use ListRow instead).

`import { DescriptionList } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/DescriptionList.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/DescriptionList.md) · Story: `Components/Terminal/DescriptionList`

**`DescriptionListItem`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `term` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | The key ("Kernel", "Region"). |
| `description` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | The value. |
| `key` | `string` |  | Stable React key. |

**`DescriptionListProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` (required) | `DescriptionListItem[]` |  | Pairs to render, in order. |
| `layout` | `"inline"` `"stacked"` | `"inline"` | `inline` puts term and value on one row (default); `stacked` puts the term above. |
| `leader` | `boolean` | `false` | Dotted leader between term and value (inline layout only). |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes for the `<dl>`. |

### Kbd

Inline keyboard key for shortcut hints.

**Use instead:** code, file names or command text (use a plain `<code>` element instead) or a status or count chip (use Badge instead).

`import { Kbd } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/Kbd.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/Kbd.md) · Story: `Components/Terminal/Kbd`

**`KbdProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `keys` | `string[]` |  | Keys of a combo, in press order (`["Ctrl", "Shift", "P"]`). |
| `children` | `ReactNode` |  | A single key label (`<Kbd>Esc</Kbd>`). |
| `size` | `"sm"` `"md"` | `"sm"` | Key size: sm 20px (default) or md 24px. |
| `separator` | `ReactNode` | `"+"` | Visible separator between combo keys (default "+"). |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes for the outer `<kbd>`. |

### LogView

A monospace scrolling log: build output, server logs, job runs.

**Use instead:** records with columns to compare (use Table instead) or a short list of events people act on (use ListRow instead).

`import { LogView } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/LogView.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/LogView.md) · Story: `Components/Terminal/LogView`

**`LogLine`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` (required) | `string \| number` |  | Stable id (used as the React key; keep it unique and stable across appends). |
| `text` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | The message. |
| `level` | `"info"` `"warning"` `"error"` `"debug"` |  | Severity. |
| `timestamp` | `string` |  | Timestamp text, pre-formatted ("12:04:01"). |

**`LogViewProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lines` (required) | `LogLine[]` |  | Lines to show, oldest first. |
| `autoScroll` | `boolean` | `true` | Follow new lines to the bottom (default true). |
| `showLineNumbers` | `boolean` | `false` | Show a gutter of 1-based line numbers (default false). |
| `wrap` | `boolean` | `true` | Wrap long lines instead of scrolling horizontally (default true). |
