| `framed` | `boolean` | `true` | Draw the plate ring frame (default true). |
| `onFollowChange` | `(following: boolean) => void` |  | Fires when following pauses (user scrolled up) or resumes. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes for the frame. |

### Meter

A gauge for a value in a known range (disk, quota, battery), not a progress bar. `role="meter"` with `aria-valuenow` / `min` / `max` / `aria-valuetext`, drawn as stepped blocks on the pixel grid.

**Use instead:** a task moving toward completion (use ProgressBar instead) or work of unknown length (use Spinner instead).

`import { Meter } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/Meter.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/Meter.md) · Story: `Components/Terminal/Meter`

**`MeterProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` (required) | `number` |  | Current value. |
| `min` | `number` | `0` | Lower bound (default 0). |
| `max` | `number` | `100` | Upper bound (default 100). |
| `low` | `number` |  | Upper edge of the low region. |
| `high` | `number` |  | Lower edge of the high region. |
| `optimum` | `number` |  | The ideal value; decides which region reads as good. |
| `label` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | Visible label ("Disk"). |
| `valueText` | `string` |  | Human-readable value, shown next to the label and used as `aria-valuetext` ("42 GB of 64 GB"). |
| `tone` | `"primary"` `"neutral"` `"info"` `"success"` `"warning"` `"error"` |  | Force a tone instead of deriving it from the thresholds. |
| `segments` | `number` | `20` | Number of blocks the range is divided into (default 20). |
| `size` | `"sm"` `"md"` | `"md"` | Block height: sm 8px, md 12px (default). |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes for the wrapper. |

### StatusLine

The bottom bar of a terminal app (vim, tmux): `left`, `center`, and `right` zones of `StatusLineSegment`s.

**Use instead:** a message the user must read in full or act on (use Alert instead, or Toast for a transient confirmation) or the app's top bar (use AppHeader instead).

`import { StatusLine, StatusLineSegment } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/StatusLine.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/StatusLine.md) · Story: `Components/Terminal/StatusLine`

**`StatusLineProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `left` | `ReactNode` |  | Left zone segments (mode, branch, file). |
| `center` | `ReactNode` |  | Center zone segments (message, progress). |
| `right` | `ReactNode` |  | Right zone segments (position, encoding, clock). |
| `live` | `boolean` | `false` | Announce changes politely (`role="status"`). |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the bar (default "Status"). |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes for the bar. |

**`StatusLineSegmentProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes for the segment. |
| `icon` | `IconSlot` |  | Icon before the text, a TuiIcon name or an element. |
| `tone` | `"neutral"` `"primary"` `"success"` `"warning"` `"error"` `"info"` | `"neutral"` | Semantic tone (default "neutral"). |
| `children` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | Segment text. |

### TreeView

Hierarchical list with expandable branches (file trees, outlines).

**Use instead:** site or app navigation (use SideNav instead) or a few collapsible content sections (use Accordion instead).

`import { TreeView } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/TreeView.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/TreeView.md) · Story: `Components/Terminal/TreeView`

**`TreeNode`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` (required) | `string` |  | Unique, stable id across the whole tree. |
| `label` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | Row content. |
| `textValue` | `string` |  | Plain-text label for type-ahead when `label` is not a string. |
| `icon` | `IconSlot` |  | Optional icon before the label: a TuiIcon name or an element. |
| `children` | `TreeNode[]` |  | Child nodes. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  | Skip this node for selection and activation (it stays focusable). |

**`TreeViewProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `nodes` (required) | `TreeNode[]` |  | Root nodes. |
| `aria-label` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the tree, such as "Files"; this or `aria-labelledby` is required. |
| `aria-labelledby` | `string` |  | Id of a visible heading naming the tree; use it instead of `aria-label` when such a heading exists. |
| `expanded` | `string[]` |  | Ids of open branches (controlled). |
| `defaultExpanded` | `string[]` | `[]` | Ids of branches open on first render (uncontrolled). |
| `onExpandedChange` | `(expanded: string[]) => void` |  | Fires with the next list of open branch ids. |
| `selected` | `string \| null` |  | Selected node id (controlled). `null` for no selection. |
| `defaultSelected` | `string \| null` | `null` | Node selected on first render (uncontrolled). |
| `onSelectedChange` | `(id: string) => void` |  | Fires when the selection changes. |
| `onActivate` | `(id: string) => void` |  | Fires when a node is activated with Enter or a click (open the file, go to the route). |
| `typeahead` | `boolean` | `true` | Type-ahead on printable keys (default true). |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` | Set while the nodes are on their way: three Skeleton rows replace the nodes and the tree gets `aria-busy` until it is false again. |
| `emptyState` | `ReactNode` |  | What to show when `nodes` is empty: a sentence, or an `EmptyState size="sm"` with `titleAs="p"`. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes for the tree root. |

### Window

A framed terminal pane: the large plate ring (stroke layer + fill inset 1px), a TUI title bar (title, a hairline rule filling the gap, optional `status` text and `actions`), and a keyboard-focusable scroll body named by the title.

**Use instead:** a general content container on a page (use Card instead) or a plain surface with padding (use Box instead). Window is for terminal-style panes, as in Patterns/WorkbenchSplit.

`import { Window } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/Window.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/Window.md) · Story: `Components/Terminal/Window`

**`WindowProps`**

| Prop | Accepts | Default | Use |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | Pane title shown in the title bar; also names the pane and its scroll region. |
| `status` | `ReactNode` |  | Short status text at the right of the title bar ("tail -f", "3 errors", "12:04"). |
| `actions` | `ReactNode` |  | Title bar actions (icon Buttons, a Badge). |
| `active` | `boolean` | `false` | Marks the focused pane: the accent ring, a muted title bar and a ChevronRight marker, so focus never relies on colour alone. |
| `titleAs` | `"h1"` `"h2"` `"h3"` `"h4"` `"h5"` `"h6"` `"span"` | `"h2"` | Heading element used for the title (default "h2"). |
| `scroll` | `boolean` | `true` | Scrolling body (default true). |
| `children` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | Pane content. |
| `className` | `string` |  | Extra classes for the outer frame (set width / height here). |
| `bodyClassName` | `string` |  | Extra classes for the body (padding, max-height). |

## Theme

### ThemeToggle

ThemeToggle is a ready-made light/dark control: a small `Switch` with a 1-bit Moon or Sun icon in the knob and a "Dark" / "Light" label beside it.

**Use instead:** any other on/off setting (use Switch instead). ThemeToggle only reads and writes the theme.

`import { ThemeToggle } from '@scorp-ds/components';`

Status: stable · Spec: [`docs/specs/ThemeToggle.md`](https://github.com/sachahurley/scorp-ds/blob/main/docs/specs/ThemeToggle.md) · Story: `Components/Theme/ThemeToggle`
